title: Checkout text cleanup
hints: Every string method returns a **new** string, so chain them: `title.trim().toLowerCase()…`. Annotate each parameter as `string`.

`slugify`: trim, lowercase, then `replaceAll(" ", "-")`. `maskCard`: take the last four with `slice(-4)`, then fill the front with `*` up to the original length; `padStart(length, "*")` does exactly that. `isPdf`: lowercase first, then `endsWith`.

function maskCard(card: string): string { return card.slice(-4).padStart(card.length, "*"); }  ·  slugify returns `title.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll(" ", "-")`  ·  isPdf returns `filename.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf")`.
